standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145119Z. The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. This issue does not pass the verification gate: tools/check.py --all reports beef/2026-10 FAIL on the figure 28.5. That figure is the Choice less Select cutout year-over-year change printed in numbers.md. tools/issue.py computes it inline when it formats the table (numbers_md_beef) and never stores it in numbers.json, so numbers.md asserts a figure the computed set does not hold. The defect is not new: the September baseline prints the same row with -6.5%, also unstored, and passed only because -6.5 happens to equal two unrelated stored values, cutout_select trailing_4wk_yoy_pct and fed_cattle_dressed yoy_pct. That is the weakness PROVENANCE.md records under the verification gate, that a figure equal to an unrelated stored value passes. This month the printed value matches nothing stored, so the check fails and the defect is visible. It is left standing for a decision: either issue.py stores a change figure for the spread, or it prints no change for that row. No figure from this row may appear in prose until that is settled. Other gaps in this month's figures: the derived Choice cutout less fed cattle dressed price carries no prior-year figure, and its two legs are different weeks, the cutout week ending 2026-10-16 against the cattle week ending 2026-10-13. The NASS cattle-on-feed inventory is 2026-09 while placements and marketings are 2026-08, and none of the three carries a two-year comparison. The weekly cattle and beef summary is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. Publication gated by FA-D-20260923-01 as amended by FA-D-20260923-02 and FA-D-20260923-04.
